background_story: Vincent was a renowned botanist with a passion for the rare and unusual. His life's work was dedicated to studying lithophytes, plants that grow in rocky crevices and thrive in the most inhospitable environments. Vincent's fascination with these hardy plants began on a childhood trip to the mountains, where he marveled at the way they clung to life on sheer rock faces. As he delved deeper into his research, Vincent became particularly obsessed with a species of lithophyte that only bloomed under the light of a full moon. He spent years tracking down this elusive plant, finally discovering it in a remote canyon. Vincent's discovery sparked a new wave of interest in lithophytes, and he became known as the leading expert in the field, earning the nickname 'The Rock Gardener'.
